correctness.rationale: A three-pair pigeonhole argument constructs a size-eight transversal of all length-six burst shadows. Equality forces exactly one word in each of eight explicitly enumerated buckets. The complete 36-candidate recursion has node counts 1,5,13,28,17,8,11,2,2 and produces exactly the two stated eight-word codes. Their deletion balls are disjoint and partition all 16 outputs; XOR closure establishes three-dimensional linearity. Independently implemented exhaustive integer-bitmask DP over 65536 received states also gives optimum 8 and number of maxima 2. Both package-local verifiers executed successfully.

value.rationale: The error model is the classical exactly-two-adjacent-deletion synchronization channel. Length six is the natural first binary case with three disjoint length-two windows and a majority-bit transversal. The finding gives a sharp bound strictly stronger than the available general nine-word bound, determines all equality cases, and proves unforced linearity and perfect coverage of every possible receiver output. This natural complete extremal classification is not just a checksum instance or a minor numeric improvement.
